title: Procurement Cluster: Enablers for Safe Integration of Military Air Capabilities in the European Sky - Information Session 4 July 2024 (online)
description: In the context of the cluster of Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) related projects that aim at providing the sought “UAS Enablers for Safe Airspace Integration in European Skyes”, the European Defence Agency (EDA) intends to launch a tender with four lots to support the progress of safe airspace integration of UAS, from low level to high altitude operations (HAO). -------- As part of the forthcoming tender, EDA is organising an information session 04 July 2024, to be held virtually, via WebEx (see below additional information). -------- Lot 1: UAS Single European Sky Experimental Integration: In a drive to elevate the capabilities of European-made low-cost tactical UAS for precision navigation, the new project focuses on two key objectives. Firstly, it seeks to enhance their operational resilience in challenging environments for safe airspace integration – specifically those with limited or denied GNSS access and potential electronic jamming threats. Secondly, the project will leverage recent breakthroughs in EU space-based services alongside onboard sensor fusion powered by artificial intelligence. This integration aims to achieve unwavering navigation accuracy regardless of spectrum availability, demonstrably validating its effectiveness through real-world proof-of-concept and demonstration phases. The successful development of these advanced navigation capabilities for UAS aims to ensure their safe integration into the airspace. --------Lot 2: Risk Assessment for UAS operations: The objective of this lot is to expand the current online tool supporting the MIL-UAS-SPECIFIC methodology (see EDA webpage https://eda.europa.eu/mil-uas-specific-study) to automatize most of the risk assessment process by leveraging the – regularly updated - MIL-UAS-SPECIFIC methodology or any other harmonised Risk assessment methodology accepted by the military (e.g., SORA). The current online tool will become a “networking/connecting” online tool, with selectable Risk assessment methodologies running back office, including a selectable accepted risk level for the UAS operations to cover operations in peace, crisis and war times. -------- Lot 3: Higher Airspace Operations (HAO) study: HAO have been in the spotlight. The upcoming EASA regulatory work requires that the civil–military aspects are included. The objective is to clarify specific civil–military aspects in the domain of HAO in order to: a) analyse the security risks; b) Address potential challenges in order to avoid any adverse impact on national security and defence capabilities with an EU approach; c) Ensure military access to higher airspace. Take advantage of all opportunities, particularly those offered by the civil-military collaboration make the most of the identified synergies. -------- Lot 4: Consultancy services for needs assessment, market research and consultation, analysis of the state-of-the-art: The surge in small and mid-sized UAS operating under the “specific” category of operations, is prompting collaboration between authorities, regulators, and UAS operators to ensure safe integration into existing airspace. This project aims to bridge the gap by assessing the specific needs of military UAS users and leverage the dual-use technology towards the safe integration into European airspace. This project has two key objectives: a) to understand end-user needs for safe airspace integration. b) to evaluate technologies for enhanced UAS integration, including the analysis of state-of-the-art of current conspicuity, ATM and positioning technologies within the EU market, that can enable safe UAS integration. c) the organisation of market consultation sessions with stakeholders

title: HIGH ISOLATION SINGLE APERTURE TRANSMIT-RECEIVE KA-BAND FLAT PANEL ANTENNA TO ENABLE FULL-DUPLEX OPERATION - EXPRO+
description: Objective: Enabling full duplex operation for Ka-band satcom terminals based on single Tx/Rx radiating aperture flat panel antennasby providing high isolation between the transmit and receive ports.Description: Satcom terminals at Ku or Ka based on single Tx/Rx aperture typically provide half duplex services, which reduces the available data rate. To enable full-duplex operation, high isolation between the Tx and Rx chains has to be implemented. While significant advancements in satcom terminal technologiesparticularly flat panel antennas with single aperture for transmit and receivehave been made outside Europe, the availability of such technologies in Europe remains limited. The activity focuses on the on the definition and implementation of development of a flat panel antenna operating in the SATCOM Ka band based on a single transmit and receive shared aperture, providing sufficient isolation between the Tx and Rx ports to enable full-duplex operation. The transmit and receive chains function at different frequencies. Therefore, a radiating aperture supporting both frequency bands will have to be designed. The isolation between the Tx and Rx ports will have to be provided at antenna element and/or feeding line level. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Consolidation of the requirements, - Trade-off analysis among several solutions and identification of the most promising antenna configuration, - Design and detailed analysis, - Manufacture and testing of a representative simplified antenna Breadboard

title: Motorizare DualAx pentru EQ5
description:
Motorizarea pe ambele axe este foarte utilă când observați diferite zone ale Lunii sau când încercați să găsiți diferite obiecte pentru astrofotografie. După ce centrați un obiect în câmpul vizual, este foarte convenabil să folosiți unitatea de control pentru a mișca ușor telescopul, de exemplu pentru a explora diferite zone ale Lunii. Sistemul dual axis permite de asemenea menținerea unui obiect în centru în timpul astrofotografiei. Unitatea de control are viteze de 2x, 8x, 16x. Folosiți viteza 2x pentru o deplasare ușoară în timpul fotografiei și celelalte viteze mai mari pentru a găsi sau centra obiectele. Montarea kitului este foarte simplă. Tensiunea necesară este de 6V (compartimentul pentru baterii este inclus). Pentru o urmărire corectă este nevoie de o aliniere polară cât mai precisă.
